lines.text: Many learners say: I arrived to the city yesterday.
Better: I arrived in the city yesterday.
In! We arrived in the city at night.

data.wrong: I arrived to the city yesterday.
data.right: I arrived in the city yesterday.

quiz.stem: We arrived ___ the city at night.

native.tip: Приехать в город — “arrive in”: “I arrived in the city yesterday.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I arrived to the city yesterday”? 😅 По-русски «приехал в город», и после глагола движения хочется сказать “to”, но после “arrive” нужен “in.” Правильно: “I arrived in the city yesterday.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “in.” Приехать в город — arrive in. Скажи вслух: “I arrived in … yesterday.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: For a city, use “arrive in”: “I arrived in the city yesterday.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I arrived to the city yesterday”? 😅 In Russian we go “to” a place, so “to” slips in, but after “arrive” English needs “in.” Correct: “I arrived in the city yesterday.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
